svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Box: 2 mm aluminium folded to 270 long x 300 wide x 90 tall, open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top, corners riveted or welded; gasket on the top flange (IP54).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: 2 mm aluminium, 270 x 300 with a 6 mm down-turned edge; held by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: six M5 screws into rivet nuts in the box flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: right side, 40 mm for the disconnect, 180 from the front, 45

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up; rear face, 22 mm for the emergency stop, 80 left of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 up; cable glands as the wiring needs, never in the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feet (make 4): 25 x 20 x 3 angle, 24 long; 9 mm hole in the flat leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 from the box side. Rivet the upright leg to the box side with two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.8 mm rivets, 20 and 210 mm from the front, bottoms flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the box stands on the top plate; one M8 bolt through each foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid top is no more than 320 mm above the floor when fitted.
